category_title: Middle school student with autism and language impairment exhibiting socially inappropriate communication
minimal_context: Molly is sitting with her general education reading group while they read an article about Japan, but she has been given a separate coloring worksheet to complete.
dialogue:
TUTOR: The rest of the group is reading an article about Japan. Molly, here is a worksheet for you to color while they read.

STUDENT: (Laughs aloud) Worksheet for you to color.

TUTOR: Yes, go ahead and start coloring.

STUDENT: (Makes inappropriate noises for bodily functions while sitting next to the group)

TUTOR: Please work quietly on your coloring.

STUDENT: (Turns her body to look away from the instructional personnel and her collaborative general education classmates, completely ignoring the unrelated worksheet)

options.A: Provide a clear beginning and end for each task during the general education reading group activities.
options.B: Collaboratively plan instructional activities and identify accommodations or modifications for the student's use in general education activities.
options.C: Offer the student options for summative presentation topics with open-ended format possibilities for presenting new knowledge.
options.D: Increase the duration of the general education reading group lessons to 30 minutes rather than 15 minutes.
